name: bimtrack-tests
description: Tes otomatis BIMTRACK (unit Vitest + aturan Firestore di Emulator). Aplikasi ada di bimtrack-user/ dan bimtrack-admin/, masing-masing punya package.json sendiri.

scripts.test:rules: firebase emulators:exec --only firestore --project demo-bimtrack "vitest run --config vitest.rules.config.js"
scripts.test:all: npm run test:unit && npm run test:rules
